task: Restore the "Processed in: Ns" metadata row for interactive-only assistant turns by finalizing processingTime on terminal stream chunks and rendering zero-valued durations.

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: chatGeneration store (_handleStreamResponse finalization, _handleChunk terminal-chunk termination), ChatAiMessage component (processingTime memo / metadata row), unit tests for both
component_scope.layers: UI (React component), State/Store (valtio store + stream chunk handling)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: One behavioural decision had to be made in-flight and is encoded in code comments and a test: a stream that ends without a terminal `last` chunk (server-side cut, proxy timeout) deliberately leaves processingTime unset rather than labelling a truncated turn as complete.

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Changes land in the shared streaming finalization path (_handleStreamResponse / _handleChunk) exercised by every chat turn, not only interactive ones; termination is now decided by the chunk `last` flag alone, and a capturedStreamText fallback was added to preserve already-streamed text; regression blast radius extends to regular text responses, workflow chats and abort handling
technical_risk.mitigation: Five new unit tests pin the finalization contract (interactive-only turn, regular text turn, stream ending without a terminal chunk, terminal chunk carrying an interactive request) plus a component test for the 0.00s edge case; change is additive to existing conditionals and trivially revertible

key_reasoning.reason: The fix rewrites stream finalization semantics in chatGeneration.ts: processingTime is now assigned whenever the terminal chunk arrives (response.last || generated || capturedStreamText) instead of only when text was produced, and _handleChunk terminates on `last` regardless of payload. Both paths are shared by every chat turn, so the change is low-effort but wide-reach.
4 files changed (283 insertions, 13 deletions) across two areas of src/: the valtio store and the chat message component, of which two are tests and one is a brand-new component test file.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): streaming red flag — the change alters chunk-level stream termination and finalization behaviour on the shared real-time streaming path, not just the interactive branch.
